services.name: Aerial Wildlife Management
services.desc: Richard Sidebottom brings a wealth of experience and expertise to the esteemed Aerial Wildlife Management and Hog Hunting community, having dedicated numerous years to the field. With an impressive flight record of over 10,000 hours piloting helicopters, Richard stands as one of the most experienced Hog hunting pilots in the state of Texas. Since the State of Texas legalized the practice of aerially removing Feral hogs, Richard has been utilizing helicopters to effectively curtail the feral hog population. services.name: Flight Training
services.desc: Do you want to learn to fly? Look no further! Our Schweizer helicopter training program offers specialized instruction to help you master these versatile aircraft. We also offer advanced training in our Bell 206 & Astar. Located just 14 nautical miles north of downtown Fort Worth in Tarrant County, Texas Hicks Airfield offers ample open airspace for pilots to enjoy their flights without congestion. Whether you’re practicing maneuvers or simply taking in the scenic views, you’ll find plenty of room to fly. Just a short distance from Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW), Hicks Airfield allows easy access for private pilots and charter flights. Age: Minimum of 16 years old for medical

blurb: North Texas Helicopters offers flight training programs including Private Pilot Certificate, Commercial Pilot License, Instrument training, and Flight Instructor programs. They provide aerial services such as vegetation management, power line inspection, pipeline patrol, aerial wildlife management, LiDAR mapping, and aerial photography and filming. Their team uses advanced technology for detailed inspections and high-quality imaging.
